sections.markdown:
## C — Disability licensing and additional driver services
FACT_ID: sec03-F01 | anchor: A01
An intermediate license expires automatically 30 days after its holder's seventeenth birthday. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F02 | anchor: A01
Before licensing an applicant with a disability, Driver Services may require a physician-completed medical or vision statement. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F03 | anchor: A01
When needed for safe vehicle operation, WYDOT must license the applicant with restrictions recommended by the applicant's physician, optometrist or ophthalmologist. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F04 | anchor: A01
A skills test may also lead to restrictions needed for a disabled applicant to operate safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F05 | anchor: A01
The Wyoming Division of Criminal Investigation serves as liaison among local law enforcement, the National Weather Service, broadcasters and DOT for Amber Alerts. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F06 | anchor: A01
An Amber Alert can be activated only after every listed activation criterion has been met. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F07 | anchor: A01
An abducted child is a required condition for an Amber Alert. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F08 | anchor: A01
The abducted child must be 17 or younger for the listed Amber Alert criteria. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F09 | anchor: A01
The child must face immediate danger of serious bodily harm or death for an Amber Alert. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F10 | anchor: A01
Amber Alert activation requires enough descriptive information to support a belief that broadcasting can help recovery. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-F11 | anchor: A02
When an Amber Alert is activated, motorists should pay attention to its information. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F12 | anchor: A02
WYDOT keeps a computerized driving record for each driver in the state. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F13 | anchor: A02
The driving record includes convictions and adverse actions resulting from convictions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F14 | anchor: A02
A driver can obtain a personal driving-record copy at a local examination station by providing a license or other legal identification and paying the fee. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F15 | anchor: A02
A legal parent or guardian may obtain a child's driving record while the child is under 18. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F16 | anchor: A02
To obtain another person's driving record, a requester must present that person's written release to the examiner. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F17 | anchor: A02
A person may request a personal driving record by sending the department a written request with the required fee. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F18 | anchor: A02
A credit-card payment request for a driving record must be stated in the written request with a phone number and email address for contact. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F19 | anchor: A02
The federal Driver's Privacy Protection Act bars WYDOT from supplying personal information for surveys, marketing or solicitations. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F20 | anchor: A02
Photographs, digital images, signatures, phone numbers and medical or disability information are personal information under the privacy discussion. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F21 | anchor: A02
The privacy discussion does not prohibit release of records about crashes, driving violations or license and registration status. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F22 | anchor: A02
Wyoming license and ID applications ask whether the applicant wants to register as an organ donor. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F23 | anchor: A02
DOT is authorized to send donor-status information electronically to the Donor Registry. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F24 | anchor: A02
For a donor under 18, a parent or guardian must sign to approve the anatomical gift. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-F25 | anchor: A02
A person who chooses organ donation receives a donor designation on the driver license or ID card. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0017]

Misconceptions: An Amber Alert requires the complete listed criteria, while a driver-record release to another person requires written consent; these are different service decisions.
Mnemonics: Recall index: alert criteria, record permission, donor choice, accessibility; this is an authored organizer for cited service categories.
Glossary: Recall terms: intermediate-license expiration, Amber Alert, driver record, donor designation, disabled placard and medical alert.
Dynamic facts: Website addresses and service contacts are withheld; fee and current administrative applicability need freshness review. The printed no-cost placard policy is recorded only as a staged handbook rule.
